title: What are your biggest 180/About Face movies and why?

commenti.body:
I wasn't a big fan of Don't Look Up when it originally aired. Seemed like a weaker Dr. Strangelove.
But boy has that movie aged like fine wine. There are many reasons for my perception change, I suppose, but one certainly is I moved to the US a few years after the movie came out and so got more exposed to the specific politics it was commenting on. Another probably was globla warming becoming ever more obvious and people doubling down on crazy counterarguments. The satire became more pronounced, I guess.

I still have yet to see this one and something gives me the hunch that the hate for it is so over the top that I'll likely engage with it more fairly. 

I was not a fan of Vice, but I do love The Big Short and I'm of the opinion that McKay should keep making what he feels. He's got some undeniable movies in his pocket from the 2000s, but it's healthy for any artist to bend their comfort zone and make stuff that's out of their wheelhouse for a while.
